_comment: Per-site extraction rules, for pages the generic scorer cannot read. Consumed by extension/src/content/extract.js.
_why_fingerprinted: Changing which elements are extracted changes the sentences, so a stored position captured under an older rule may no longer match. This downgrades confidence globally when a rule is added, which is the conservative direction: claiming a position is verified when the rules did change is the worse error.

_schema.kind: article | mail — mail joins several message bodies into one document
_schema.roots: selectors for the readable content, tried in order, all matches used
_schema.skip: selectors removed from within a root before extracting
_schema.label: optional selector whose text introduces each root, e.g. a sender

_fragility: These selectors belong to applications that change without warning, and a stale one degrades to the generic scorer rather than breaking. That fallback is the reason it is safe to guess here at all.

mail.google.com._note: div.a3s is the message body and has been stable for years. Quoted replies are skipped: reading an entire thread's quote chain repeats every message once per reply.

news.ycombinator.com._note: Comments are the content here; the generic scorer reads them as link-heavy furniture and rejects them.
